lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: Select a read-only point, line or polygon and copy it to a compatible editable target, including a hidden target; reject incompatible types and lossy multipart truncation.
Choose a destination category; check matching fields, NULL, zero, int64, unbound form fields, Cancel, recreate and independent SQLite identity.
Move an editable multipart feature with one finger and rotate it with two; retain holes, scale and fixed camera, transition pointer counts, Undo/Redo, exact gesture Cancel and Save.
Check every action and full Russian mode caption in both themes and orientations with 100/130/200 percent fonts and normal/320/280 dp effective widths.
value.expected: Source remains unchanged, the destination uses normal form gates, each transform gesture is one reversible step and every bottom-panel command is reachable without overflow.
